name: King of Texas
source:
Jon Bega’s dream has just come true, he’s been drafted as the new running back for one of America’s best football team, the Dallas Sheriffs. What will happen to this athletic Louisianan when he moves up to Texas to join this new team?


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1017940/King_of_Texas]Steam[/url]]
translation:
乔恩·贝加的梦想刚刚实现，他被选为美国最好的橄榄球队之一达拉斯警长队的新跑卫。当这位运动型路易斯安那人搬到德克萨斯州加入这支新球队时，他会发生什么？


[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1017940/King_of_Texas]Steam[/url]]
